performance_claim_scope: Exact W7900 full-attention K physical-family replacement plus a 17-pair same-loaded-model B3 complete-decode screen. The separate ten-prompt packet is disclosed as noise-negative and does not replace the canonical topline.
correctness_scope: Exact CPU/fake preference and fallback routing, exact W7900 B1-B3 transaction/state/provider output, unchanged natural25 IDs and acceptance, expected kernel execution, and clean teardown.

change.mechanism: The staged native full-attention helper first asks the existing compact-Q4T16 sidecar dispatcher to own the K5120/N1024 rows 2-4 projection. If the weight lacks the sidecar or registered col4 key, the existing exact pack8 grid-Y batch remains the first fallback, followed by scalar linear dispatch.
change.why_previously_uncovered: All sixteen dense full-attention K tensors already carry the retained compact sidecar, but the staged full-attention helper predated that promotion and hard-bypassed it into the older pack8 grid-Y owner.

correctness.cpu_fake_native_cycle: 15 passed; compact sidecar is preferred when available, and missing sidecar/key preserves the pack8 grid-Y fallback.
correctness.static: py_compile passed for the runner and both changed test files; git diff --check passed.

correctness.physical_owner: The binding transaction observes no pack8 full-K grid-Y calls after promotion; the compact rowtile owners remain observed at native rows 2-4.
correctness.paired_screen: All 17 control/candidate pairs have identical output IDs and cycle acceptance ledgers.

physical_profile.protocol: Separate hermetic cached W7900 rocprofv3 kernel/marker/copy traces of the same code_merge_intervals natural25 B3 workload. Family values are call-normalized attribution; distinct-run complete walls are not compared because clocks and proposal overlap differ.

matched_module_update.interpretation: K improves exactly but the combined K/V module remains slower than Vulkan, so D27-R2 advances within the module to V.

paired_complete_decode.protocol: Same loaded model/session and buffers; separately cached warm control and candidate B3 target graphs; 17 counterbalanced code_merge_intervals natural25 pairs; 24 timed transitions; exact IDs and acceptance.

ten_prompt_disclosure.protocol: W7900 natural25 ten-prompt code/general_en/general_ja/mixed_ja_en suite, B1-B3, one warmup and one measured run, compared with the immediately prior clean direct-handoff packet.
ten_prompt_disclosure.interpretation: The unchanged c1 AR route is strongly positive while B1-B3 straddle modestly negative timing. Because the deterministic target K family and same-loaded-model complete-decode screen are positive, retain the exact ownership win but do not replace the cleaner canonical direct-handoff topline.

decision.reason: The route reuses already-resident sidecars, is BF16-bit and transaction exact, removes no fallback, cuts the intended K family by 0.908483 ms / 37.70%, and improves same-loaded-model complete decode in 13/17 pairs. The separate category packet is timing-negative within 0.44%, so canonical throughput remains unchanged.
decision.next_target: Audit and close full-attention V against the remaining combined K/V gap before advancing to the target root projection.
